source_text:
On our old fourteen-inch Videocon,
Spider-Man became "piderma," villains
vanished off the edge of the screen,
and half of the dialogue dissolved
into static. I watched with biryani
balanced on my five-year-old lap,
cheering anyway. Whenever someone
asked what I wanted to be, I shouted,
"A hero!" To me, heroes were
invincible superhumans who could help
everyone. So, whenever the movie
turned from the mask to the vulnerable
man beneath it, I turned back to my
biryani.
